children: Toro said it has agreed to acquire two medium-range tanker vessels for a total of $83.4 million.

The energy transportation services provider bought a 2018 Japanese-built MR tanker vessel named the M/T Wonder Alasia, for a purchase price of $45.9 million and took delivery of the vessel in mid-September, it said Friday.
Additionally, the company bought a 2014 Korean-built scrubber-fitted MR tanker vessel, with a price tag of $37.5 million, which the company intends to rename M/T Wonder Atria.
Both ships were acquired from unaffiliated third parties, it noted.
Toro operates a fleet of oceangoing vessels that transport refined petroleum and petrochemical gasses around the world.
